purpose: CO2+CH4 EOS-CG-2021 density bake-off for compositions other than the existing xCH4 = 0.05 production slice.

source.title: Density characteristics of CO2-CH4 binary mixtures at temperatures from (300 to 308.15) K and pressures from (2 to 18) MPa
source.method: Buoyancy - hydrostatic balance with magnetic suspension - one sinker

model.engine: teqp v0.23.1 via PhaseXpert native bridge
model.formulation: EOS-CG-2021 CO2+CH4 inherited GERG binary formulation

acceptanceContext.existingProductionReference: Ghafri 2016 xCH4 = 0.05 high-temperature supercritical gate has 1.1254775% AARD and 1.99333% worst relative density deviation.
acceptanceContext.productionExpansionDecision: No new CO2+CH4 density composition is production-enabled by this artifact; several slices converge but either exceed the prior production worst-deviation precedent or are far outside CO2-rich CCS composition targets.

compositionSummaries.decisionRationale: Full composition slice is not production-enabled because the worst density deviation exceeds the existing methane production-gate precedent of approximately 2% and the source itself identifies high-CO2 near-critical disagreement; retain as quantitative diagnostic evidence.
